card.name: Linking words before equipment parts
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'is', 'be' and 'necessary' that come just before a device, part or equipment noun, mostly in inhaler and nebulizer setup instructions and in electronics text about parts.

modes.label: Device use and upkeep
modes.description: Small words in inhaler or nebulizer instructions about priming, replacing or connecting equipment.
modes.example: Prior to first use, the STIOLTO RESPIMAT cartridge is inserted into the STIOLTO RESPIMAT inhaler and the unit<< is>> primed.

modes.label: Parts and components
modes.description: The word 'of' or a verb right before a count or mention of parts or components in product or electronics descriptions.
